items.problem: `copy_text` of an empty string in a headless run of `QACore` (or on a platform without a clipboard) matches two rows of `## error` (lines 117 and 118) with different log levels (error and warn), and `## behavior` lists the three conditions without an order, so the log level of that call differs per implementation

The condition under which `request_review` of the adapter reports a failure is set only for `android` (line 62). For `ios` and `macos` (`SKStoreReviewController`, line 52-53), whether the adapter reports a failure (e.g. no foreground window scene for the scene-taking request call) or always reports success is not set, so the `Failed` row of `## error` (line 111) can differ per implementation on those platforms
